settings.tab_content: Engineered using Pre-Preg carbon fiber sheets bonded under extreme pressure and heat. Yields maximum impact dissipation at a structural weight of only 1280 grams.
Optimized with an integrated rear spoiler that stabilizes laminar flow and reduces high-speed drag coefficient to 0.28 Cd.
Equipped with a Class 1 optical distortion-free shield preppped for Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog inserts. Includes dark smoke secondary shield.
Fully certified under the latest ECE 22.06 and DOT standards. Approved for official FIM and AMA professional closed-circuit racing events.
